greetings: Hi there! I'm the Harvest Table Co. virtual sales agent. How can I support your event planning today?
Hello! Ready to explore premium catering options together?

faqs.answer: We support executive meetings, town halls, conferences, product launches, and hybrid events with full-service catering.
Our culinary team crafts bespoke menus for weddings, anniversaries, birthdays, and private dinners with on-site chefs.
Pricing starts around $55 per guest for corporate experiences and $80 per guest for weddings. We will confirm after understanding your menu preferences and guest count.
A dedicated advisor will respond within one business day with availability and next steps.
We cater across the Greater Chicago Area including downtown, North Shore, and nearby suburbs.
Reach us anytime at concierge@harvesttableco.com or call (312) 555-0180.

quoteTemplate: To prepare a custom proposal I just need your name, event type, event date, guest count, and any special notes. Once I have that, our human advisor will follow up shortly!
